note: The sources this pack's builder reads, with the evidence for each licence. The committed copy is the catalogue plus what a probe measured on 2026-10-10 WITHOUT downloading the large files (sizes by HEAD); `scripts/packs/map-serbia/build.mjs` REWRITES this file inside the pack, filling `fetched`, `size` and `sha256` — and the per-file digests under `files` — with what its own run measured. A null digest is a source this repository never stored: the planet build is cut by byte-range request and the two `-latest` Geofabrik files change daily, so the only honest record of those is the one the build writes.
